# Fission

> Temporary compute for your coding agent, paid through MPP with Tempo.

- [Agent skill](skills/fission/SKILL.md): validate a change, collect evidence, and return a timestamped report.
- [Agent entry point](AGENTS.md): task completion, authorization, and repository boundaries.
- [Rental](docs/rental.md): quotes, budgets, funding, jobs, exports, and recovery.
- [Workload cards](docs/workloads.md): indexed Foundry, symbolic execution, Reth, Tempo, Base and BSC capabilities with prerequisites, evidence boundaries, and related tasks.
- [Harnesses](docs/harnesses.md): Foundry, Reth, Tempo, source builds, readiness, local preservation, portable experiments, and custom recipes.
- [Synced Reth](docs/reth.md): snapshot sizing, checkpoint selection, and node readiness.
- [Install](README.md): build and open the Rust TUI.

Use `fission help guides` for the local topic index, then `fission help TOPIC/SECTION` for the relevant complete section. Use `fission help` for command syntax and `fission capabilities [ECOSYSTEM]` for structured profiles and workload IDs.
